description: Holds submit-for-review commands, App Store Connect MCP submit tools and over-the-air publishes (eas update, CodePush, Shorebird) while the appstore-shield gate says HOLD, asks on WARN and before any production OTA publish, denies agent attempts to run the human-only attest/ack commands, to run the CLI detached or with a cleared environment, or to write the review ledger, and asks before edits to .appstore-shield settings. A guardrail for a cooperative agent, not a sandbox (see SECURITY.md).
